    Ported from TauCeti (TauCeti.RepresentationTheory.Quiver.AffineD.FiniteRepType, commit 580b6f9d5, Apache 2.0).

    The extended Dynkin quiver D~ₙ has infinite representation type #

    The quiver LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineD m, whose underlying graph is the extended Dynkin diagram D~ₘ₊₄, has infinitely many finite-dimensional indecomposable representations over every field (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.not_isFiniteRepType_affineD).

    The proof reduces to the four subspace quiver, the case m = 0, which is already known to have infinite representation type (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.not_isFiniteRepType_subspace_fin_four). A representation M of the four subspace quiver is stretched along the spine (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineDStretchRep): its centre space is placed at every spine vertex, with the identity on every spine arrow, and its four outer spaces at the four leaves, each leaf arrow acting as the corresponding arrow of M.

    Stretching is fully faithful (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.fullyFaithfulAffineDStretchFunctor). A morphism between stretched representations commutes with the identity maps along the spine, so its components at all the spine vertices agree; that common component, together with the components at the leaves, is a morphism of the original representations. Stretching therefore preserves indecomposability and reflects isomorphism, and it preserves finite-dimensionality, so it embeds the finite-dimensional indecomposables of the four subspace quiver, up to isomorphism, in those of LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineD m.

    Main definitions #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineDCollapseFunctor: the functor collapsing the spine to the four subspace centre.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineDStretchRep: a representation of the four subspace quiver, stretched along the spine of LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineD m.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineDStretchFunctor: stretching, as a functor.

    Main results #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.fullyFaithfulAffineDStretchFunctor: stretching is fully faithful.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.IsFiniteRepType.subspace_fin_four_of_affineD: finite representation type of LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineD m would force it on the four subspace quiver.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.not_isFiniteRepType_affineD: LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineD m has infinite representation type over every field.

    Implementation notes #

    LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineDCollapseFunctor and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineDStretchRep carry @[expose] for the reason recorded on LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.subspaceJordanRep: the vertex spaces are needed definitionally to state the homogeneous arrow equations. Stretching is precomposition with the functor collapsing the spine to the centre of the four subspace quiver, using CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskeringLeft.

    References #

    • I. Assem, D. Simson, A. Skowroński, Elements of the Representation Theory of Associative Algebras, Volume I, Chapter VII.
    • H. Derksen, J. Weyman, An Introduction to Quiver Representations, Chapter 4.

    def LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineDCollapseFunctor (m : ℕ) :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (CategoryTheory.Paths (Quiver.AffineD m)) (CategoryTheory.Paths (Quiver.Subspace (Fin 4)))

    Collapse the spine to the centre of the four subspace quiver, sending spine arrows to identity paths and leaf arrows to the corresponding outer-to-centre paths.

            The extended Dynkin quiver D~ₘ₊₄ has infinite representation type over every field. The stretches along its spine of the Jordan block configurations of four subspaces (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.subspaceJordanRep) are infinitely many pairwise non-isomorphic finite-dimensional indecomposables.
